description:
Retire several steering rules in one transaction.

    Pass the project id and 1-100 rule `id` values from list_steering_rules.
    Works for active and pending rules, including a retro kaizen the automatic
    curation pass protects. Each changed rule is retired with one audit row;
    a rule that is already retired returns `changed: false`. If any requested
    rule is not this project's, nothing is retired and the call returns the
    same 404 as a single-rule call. There is no un-retire: to bring a
    convention back, submit it as a new Request. Running iterations keep the
    prompt they started with.
name: retire_steering_rules
title: Retire Steering Rules
